notes.title: Update v1.1 - Illegal model problem - FIXED; added new features
notes.notes:
Today, 2 days after the game's release, it came to my attention that I used a model in my game that the 3D modeler/author stole from another AAA game. 

The model in question is Hitler's model, that I used pretty much everywhere in the game, so I will be replacing all instances immediately. 

I downloaded the model from sketchfab.com, a platform for indie game developers that want to use 3d models for their games. The model in question is called "Dance dance Fuhrer" and was uploaded 3 years ago by user "strangefox". He licensed the model under CC Attribution license, which means that all you have to do to use it in your commercial products is to credit the author - which I did.

But I wasn't aware until today, when I read the Steam discussions, that he stole the model from another game - Sniper Elite by Rebellion games.

Here is the link to the model and a screenshot of the whole page in case the user decides to delete it after this finding.

I hope this solves the problem, but if it doesn't, I will be available on my developer email. In any case, I will contact Rebellion studios myself and describe the problem to them. The problem has now been fixed (except for branding images, which I am changing now). The new and proper model is the one you see in the thumbnail of this announcement.

And the game also received a small update. You are now able to choose if you want the conversations to continue automatically or not, by pressing C.

https://i.imgur.com/3woZcBk.png
